description: Source code for a PySide6 QWidget class that visualizes waveform data from WAV files, including methods for loading audio, plotting waveforms, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: Plot_waveform_RT
classes.description: A QWidget subclass for real-time waveform plotting from WAV files, with controls for time interval adjustment and event handling.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Intercepts key press events and emits them via the sendEvent signal.

methods.name: get_wav_info
methods.description: Reads a WAV file and extracts the audio signal and frame rate.

methods.name: load_wav
methods.description: Loads a WAV file, storing audio data and frame rate, and returns media length and frame rate or error.

methods.name: time_interval_changed
methods.description: Adjusts the waveform display interval and updates the plot.

methods.name: plot_waveform
methods.description: Plots the waveform centered on a specified current time, with different handling for start, middle, and end of media.
